card.title: The Impossible Promise
card.instruction: Treat an old, seemingly impossible promise as fully binding, and interpret every delay as unfinished business rather than release.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You promised me a sunrise in a box last anniversary. The shelf's still ready.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: That was poetic. I can bring you breakfast in bed.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Lovely. Put the box beside the tray when it's ready.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: It won't be ready this anniversary either.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then I'll leave the shelf clear another year. Please don't buy anything that needs that space.

mechanism: A treats the promised boxed sunrise as a pending delivery, making substitute kindness and another year's delay coexist with a reserved shelf.
confusable: Unlike using an old favor as leverage, A keeps the specific impossible promise binding without replacing it with a new repayment demand.
comparison: The sunrise alternative protects space through another anniversary; the future-guest alternative makes a replacement appliance serve a century-long wait.
provenance: Direct local assistant candidate preparation; not fresh review or acceptance.
